messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT P1 — control-plane 5xx spike detected. Services affected: auth, org-lookup, billing gateway. Paging @sre-oncall. Estimated start: ~1809502400. Error rate: ~18% across control-plane routes. Auto-remediation attempted: none. Pager: https://pd.example/INC12345 :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: ack, I'm on. Triage mode ON. I'm seeing a big fanout of auth calls to idp failing with 500s, and org-lookup timeouts (504). Pulling traces now.

maria: hitting the same. example traces show auth -> idp -> 500 with `TokenService` NPE. Also org-lookup is timing out at 3s then 504. Any recent config or deploys? :thinking_face:

deploy-bot: FYI there was a config-service rollout to canary earlier today at 1809501500 (config-service v2.3.1). No full rollout.

raj: if org-lookup is timing out it could be cascading to billing/gateway because they fan out for enrichment. Recommend throttling enrichment and enabling cached fallback for org-lookup keys.

jamie: confirming some billing gateway requests to eu-billing-proxy are returning 503s — looks like downstream quota/overload. Customer reported errors for inference requests in EU.

oliver: customer-impact snapshot from SLO: ~12% failures for hosted API in eu-west-1 over last 5m, latency spikes too. Product ops pinging top 10 customers now.

product-ops: heads-up: sending a short status message to customers on the 10 affected orgs, will escalate if they hit support.

sre-oncall: mitigation plan (live): 1) enable org-lookup cached fallback for 1h 2) throttle non-essential enrichment routes (batch user metadata) 3) scale auth replicas + increase idp client retries 4) rollback canary of config-service if correlated 5) route traffic away from eu-billing-proxy to fallback region if 503 persists. I'll run steps 1-3 now.

maria: doing step 1: flipping `ENABLE_ORG_CACHE_FALLBACK=true` for control-plane via feature-flag service. Patch: `curl -X POST https://flags/api/set -d '{"ENABLE_ORG_CACHE_FALLBACK":true}'`

raj: throttling rule deployed: `traffic-router` updated to drop enrichments above 50rps per instance for 10m.

sre-oncall: scaled auth -> `kubectl -n control-plane scale deploy/auth-service --replicas=10` and bumped HPA target CPU. Also bumped idp client retries from 2->4.

jamie: routing failover in progress: switching billing gateway route from eu-billing-proxy -> eu-billing-secondary. Command: `routesctl promote eu-billing-secondary --drain 60s`

support-bot: customer messages queued: 10 customers notified, support ticket template attached.

maria: quick log snippet from auth-service showing the 500:
```
2024-11-05T17:34:51Z ERROR auth.TokenService - NullReferenceException at TokenService.Validate
stack: at TokenService.Validate(Token token) \n at AuthHandler.Handle(Request req)
```
looks like null pointer inside token validation when idp returns unusual payload.

raj: that points to idp payload shape change or unexpected empty scope. Can we add guard and release quick patch? If risky, prefer to add a defensive catch to return 401 instead of 500.

oliver: ops -> impact update: after throttle+cache+scale we see error rate drop from 18% -> 3.5% in 3m. Still some tail errors.

sre-oncall: rollback check: config-service canary is correlated (calls to config-service produce errors that bubble to auth). Rolling canary back to previous revision now: `kubectl -n control-plane rollout undo deployment/config-service --to-revision=3`

deploy-bot: rollback started at 1809502670, canary traffic shifted to v2.3.0.

maria: applying defensive guard in auth-service repo. Pushing hotfix branch with `return 401 on missing token fields` and will hotpatch.

raj: recommend we keep org-cache fallback for 30m post-stable and then monitor. Also add a short-term circuit breaker on billing proxy fanout.

sre-oncall: agreed. Enabling circuit-breaker for billing fanout now.

oliver: metrics: error rate now 0.9% across control-plane, latency returning to normal. Customer reports dropping. Product-ops continuing outreach.

product-ops: updating status page with "partial degradation mitigated, monitoring" message. Notifying customers we're following up with root cause.

maria: hotfix deployed to auth-service (v1.4.1-hotfix) and hotpatched in prod at 1809502802. No 500s from TokenService for last 2m.

sre-oncall: closing actions: - keep org-cache-fallback enabled for 30m - leave throttles and circuit-breakers for 20m then reevaluate - postmortem assigned to maria+raj+jamie, draft due EOD tomorrow - open follow-ups: add validation tests for idp payload shapes, tighten canary observability for config-service.

oliver: final numbers to include in incident report: peak 5xx 18%, duration ~12m from detection to stable, impacted region eu-west-1, mitigation: cache+throttle+scale+rollback, customer-facing messages sent.

support-bot: closing support queue for active tickets with incident tag.

sre-oncall: monitoring only. Error rate stable at ~0.6% (normal noise). I'm handing back to regular oncall at 1809502845. If anyone sees regression ping me. Good job team :clap:

maria: thanks all — creating postmortem docs now and will include playbook updates for org-lookup cache fallback and config canary checks.

product-ops: note for postmortem: include timeline of alerts, customer comms, and decision to rollback canary.

jamie: +1 on adding circuit-breakers and test harness for billing fanout.

incident-bot: Incident INC12345 marked RESOLVED at 1809502845. Severity: P1 -> resolved. Postmortem owners: maria, raj, jamie.

sre-oncall: resolved. Closing thread and moving to #postmortems. Thanks everyone.
